name: B10-0215/2024 – § 4, point 1 – Am 7
title: PROPOSAL FOR A DECISION on setting up a standing committee on Security and Defence and a standing committee on Public Health
part_text: (1)Part I, paragraph 1, point 1 is amended as follows: (a) point 1 is replaced by the following: ‘1. the common foreign and security policy(CFSP);’ (b) point 8 is replaced by the following: ‘8. issues concerning democracy, the rule of law, human rights, including the rights of minorities, in third countries and the principles of international law;’
